name: cr603_2_nantuko_landfall_pays_for_a_copy_of_the_creature
why: Springheart Nantuko, attached to a creature you control: you may pay {1}{G} as the landfall trigger resolves. Paid, you create a token that's a copy of that creature, and no Insect (UnlessSwitched$, UnlessResolveSubs$ WhenNotPaid).
